// Translated by CodeBreaker from Shapes (csharp).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Corpus.Shapes
{
    public interface IShape
    {
        string Name { get; }

        int Area();
    }

    public abstract class Shape : IShape
    {
        private static int made;

        public int Id { get; private set; }

        public abstract string Name { get; }

        protected Shape()
        {
            made++;
            Id = made;
        }

        public static int Made => made;

        public abstract int Area();

        public virtual string Describe() => $"{Name}#{Id} area={Area()}";
    }

    public class Rect : Shape
    {
        public int W { get; set; }

        public int H { get; set; }

        public Rect(int w, int h)
        {
            W = w;
            H = h;
        }

        public override string Name => "rect";

        public override int Area() => W * H;
    }

    public class Square : Rect
    {
        public Square(int side) : base(side, side)
        {
        }

        public override string Name => "square";

        public override string Describe() => $"[{base.Describe()}]";
    }

    public class Tri : Shape
    {
        private readonly int b;
        private readonly int h;

        public Tri(int b, int h)
        {
            this.b = b;
            this.h = h;
        }

        public override string Name => "tri";

        public override int Area() => this.b * this.h / 2;
    }

    public static class Program
    {
        public static int Total(List<IShape> shapes)
        {
            int t = 0;
            foreach (IShape s in shapes)
            {
                t += s.Area();
            }
            return t;
        }

        public static void Main()
        {
            var shapes = new List<IShape>();
            shapes.Add(new Rect(3, 4));
            shapes.Add(new Square(5));
            shapes.Add(new Tri(7, 3));
            for (int i = 0; i < shapes.Count; i++)
            {
                Shape s = (Shape)shapes[i];
                Console.WriteLine(s.Describe());
            }
            Rect r = (Rect)shapes[0];
            r.W = 10;
            Console.WriteLine($"after resize: {r.Describe()} total={Total(shapes)}");
            Console.WriteLine($"made {Shape.Made} shapes");
        }
    }
}
